name: Phoenix Drinking Water Quality Reports
known_limitations: Consumer confidence reports describe the municipal drinking-water system and regulated contaminant results. They do not establish industrial service capacity, a facility water balance, wastewater acceptance, reuse performance, or a project-level service commitment.
source_owner: City of Phoenix Water Services Department
automation_notes: Capture the newest annual report and preserve system coverage, sampling year, regulated limits, and the boundary between drinking-water quality and industrial capacity.
